title: Where is Trail Ruins?!
description: Changes the texture of blocks used in trail ruins.
body:
## About:

So, I hate trying to find trail ruins while flying on the elytra because they are almost impossible to spot. Then I got an idea what if I make a resource pack that makes the trail ruins very noticeable. And now I want to share it with other people cuz why not.

## How to find Trail Ruins:

Trail Ruins generates at the taiga, snowy taiga, old growth spruce taiga, old growth pine taiga, old growth birch forest, and the jungle. Better to search near water because sometimes it generates right in it. Oh, and don't forget to use the pack! It actually helps! (Also, the Trail Ruin on icon is real...)
